summary: The LlamaParse Startup Offer gives first-time LlamaIndex customers $2,000 in free platform credits available for one year, a priority Slack channel with a dedicated AI engineer, discounts on bulk credit purchases in production, early access to pre-release features, an alignment call with Jerry Liu, and a featured spotlight. Eligibility: first-time customers, at least $250k raised, less than $50M raised. Distinct from the public Free plan (10K credits/month on llamaindex.ai/pricing).
claim_steps: Confirm first-time customer status and funding between $250k and under $50M raised.
Apply on https://www.llamaindex.ai/startups (form on that page).
Credits are valid for one year; production bulk discounts and eng Slack are part of the accepted-startup package.
